import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final int MAXN = 50 * T + 2; // 4952

    static class Flow {
        static class Edge {
            int v, r;
            long f, c, p;
            Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
                this.v = v;
                this.r = r;
                this.f = f;
                this.c = c;
                this.p = p;
            }
        }

        static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        static boolean[] vis;
        static int[] par;
        static long[] pot;
        static long[] dist;
        static long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        static void init(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            vis = new boolean[n];
            par = new int[n];
            pot = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        static void addEdge(int u, int v, long c, long p) {
            int r = adj[v].size();
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, r, 0, c, p));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static void potInit(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, 0);
            // Bellman-Ford to set initial potentials (works for non-negative costs)
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c > 0 && pot[u] + e.p < pot[e.v]) {
                            pot[e.v] = pot[u] + e.p;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] priceRef, int n, boolean sparse, long lb) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            Arrays.fill(par, 0, n, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;

            if (sparse) {
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] cur = pq.poll();
                    int u = (int) cur[1];
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f <= e.c - lb) {
                            long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                                dist[e.v] = nd;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                                pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.v});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f <= e.c - lb) {
                            long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                                dist[e.v] = nd;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;

            long df = INF;
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
                df = Math.min(df, e.c - e.f);
                u = r.v;
            }

            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
                e.f += df;
                r.f -= df;
                priceRef[0] += df * e.p;
                u = r.v;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (pot[i] < INF) {
                    pot[i] = Math.min(INF, pot[i] + dist[i]);
                } else {
                    pot[i] = INF;
                }
            }

            return df;
        }

        static long[] minCostFlow(int s, int t, int n, boolean sparse) {
            potInit(n);
            long flow = 0;
            long[] priceRef = new long[1];
            for (long lb = 1L << 30; lb > 0; lb >>= 1) {
                long df;
                while ((df = mcf(s, t, priceRef, n, sparse, lb)) > 0) {
                    flow += df;
                }
            }
            return new long[]{flow, priceRef[0]};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;
        int nodeCount = sink + 1;
        Flow.init(nodeCount);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            Flow.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, Flow.INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Flow.INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                long cost = (j + 1L) * (j + 1L) - j * j; // 2j+1
                long capCost = cost * d + c;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, capCost);
                    Flow.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, capCost);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] result = Flow.minCostFlow(source, sink, nodeCount, true);
        long flow = result[0];
        long price = result[1];
        // flow should equal k
        System.out.println(price);
    }
}
